name: Guardian genius crossword No 204
preamble: Genius crossword 204 –  Definitions in all clues are normal, but you must count on a knowledge of French and German (as well as English) to determine a number of letters missing from their wordplay (in two cases twice). All solutions are too long for their allotted grid spaces, so the missing letters must be entered figuratively.
